{{Quote|There's an ocean planet&hellip; home to Nautolans. Glee Anselm.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] tracing [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] through the Force|audio=HomeOfNautolans-CotF.flac|<ref name="Children of the Force">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>}}
'''Glee Anselm''' {{C|{{Audio|GleeAnselm-CotF.flac|Pronunciation}}}} was a peaceful [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The planet's surface was largely covered in water or swamps, with only a few clear landmasses dotting its surface. The planet had very frequent season changes, causing it to be ravaged by intense storms with some of them turning [[Wikipedia:cyclone|cyclonic]]. The climate was moderate most of the standard year round.

==Description==
[[File:GleeAnselmAd.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Detail of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] poster depicting a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] parent and child on Glee Anselm.]]
Glee Anselm was located within a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Jalor sector/Legends|Jalor sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="EAOC" /> on the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]] between [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] and [[Ord Varee]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a mostly [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with one [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and few large landmasses. Most of its other islands and archipelagos were little more than swamps. It had a mild climate, ranging from tropical to temperate, but intense storms and hurricanes were common. Most of the planet's aquatic life, which survived in the high-pressure oceanic depths, had not been catalogued. The planet had a rotational period of 33 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] and an orbital period of 206 [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]].<ref name="TCWCG" />

==History==
The planet was home to two natural [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] and the [[Anselmi/Legends|Anselmi]]. Both races evolved naturally on the planet, the Nautolans under the water and the Anselmi on what few landmasses there were. The competitions for land probably led to the Anselmi turning into a warlike race. However, as the Nautolans gradually came to the surface and acquired land, they were able to use their natural abilities and strength to ward off the Anselmi. As a result, the Nautolans made up the majority of the population, since there were very few Anselmi left on the planet; the latter's numbers continued to diminish due to internal warfare.

During the [[Galactic War]], a popular [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] wanted to own a pair of ginxes which were considered banned as pets on Glee Anselm.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|A Nautolon's Best Friend}}</ref>

[[File:Nautolan_TCWCG.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Nautolan male.]]
Glee Anselm was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Darsana/Legends|Darsana]], who was appointed to the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] also hailed from Glee Anselm. During the waning years of the Galactic Republic, the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency offered trips to Glee Anselm<ref name="Billboard">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20100121ads/index.html|text=Coruscant Billboard from ''The Clone Wars''}}</ref> and a [[Battle of Glee Anselm|battle]] was fought on the planet during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

After the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the newly-established [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] set up a basic form of government on the planet. This system of government had ten councilors, each one with their own specific responsibility (for example: Trade/Commerce, Diplomacy, Social Affairs, and Environmental Issues).

Glee Anselm was missed by the swath of destruction cut by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] on the galaxy, though many nearby systems fell prey to the vicious alien invaders. The system would serve as a platform for the both the Republic and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] to attack Vong occupied [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]].<ref name="TEA" />
